root_cause.text: The `read_key_from_user_keying()` function in the crash_dump subsystem was logging sensitive cryptographic key material (the first 8 bytes of the dm-crypt key payload) via the `kexec_dprintk()` debug logging function, exposing the key when debug logging was enabled.
root_cause.evidence: The patch removes the `%8ph` format specifier and `dm_key->data` argument from the debug log statement. The original code logged "Get dm crypt key (size=%u) %s: %8ph\n" with `dm_key->data` as the third argument, which would print the first 8 bytes of the key payload in hexadecimal format. The fix removes this key material from the log entirely, leaving only the key size and key descriptor, which are non-sensitive metadata.

vuln_statements.content: kexec_dprintk("Get dm crypt key (size=%u) %s: %8ph\n", dm_key->key_size, dm_key->key_desc, dm_key->data);
